correctness.rationale: Read full RESULT.md and the exact small-instance checker. The only perfect matchings are cycle alternations A,B, a unique single-chord matching for each odd chord, and possibly one joint two-chord perfect matching. An unused chord becomes a simplicial cone vertex. If even chords have opposite parity and interlace, the Alexander-dual facet nerve has triangle boundary; for two odd chords it is a tetrahedron boundary or tetrahedron glued to cone over a four-cycle, both S^2. Alexander duality on 2t+2 edge vertices puts unique free homology in degree 2t-2 or 2t-3. For t>=4 complete two-skeleton ensures simple connectivity, and for t=3 missing perfect-matching triangles have conable boundaries, so Hurewicz/Whitehead gives integral homotopy spheres. As an independent check, wrote a separate recursion enumerating perfect matchings from the 2t vertex set, checked complete dual nerve f-vectors for all 36,190,595 pairs at t=3,4,5: cone 27/142/440, even-crossing sphere 6/20/50, two-odd sphere 3/28/105. Finite enumeration corroborates but is not the t-uniform proof.
